question: How much time takes its training?

evidence: Previous neural sentence embedding methods started the training from a random initialization. In this publication, we use the pre-trained BERT and RoBERTa network and only fine-tune it to yield useful sentence embeddings. This reduces significantly the needed training time: SBERT can be tuned in less than 20 minutes, while yielding better results than comparable sentence embedding methods.

title: Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks
answer_rationale: The document states that SBERT can be tuned in less than 20 minutes, which directly answers the question about the training time.
